title: Grand Orchid Ballroom
brief: A ceremonial banquet interior balancing generous scale with warmth, clarity, and effortless guest movement.
overview: The ballroom was planned as a flexible hospitality setting capable of hosting celebrations at several scales. Layered ceilings and carefully placed lighting create intimacy without diminishing the room's sense of occasion.
Durable materials are composed with a residential softness: deep green upholstery, bronze-toned detailing, and warm indirect light give the venue a recognizable identity throughout the day.
